description: Letter from Meʾir Ben-Naʿim (fl. 1785-1825 CE), but the paleography is not suggestive of his scribal hand. The letter may date from early in his career or could have been penned by a scribe on his behalf. Mentioning business matters and the name Abraham Ashkenazi. End of 18th century. (Information from CUDL)
description_he: מכתב ממאיר בן נעים, המזכיר ענייני עסקים ואת השם אברהם אשכנזי. סוף המאה ה-18. (מידע מתוך CUDL)
